issue.title: Reuse a resolved Spotify short link's episode page in create and ingest instead of fetching it twice

task_type_fields.proposal:
Proposed by bob-cli-os.5 note #2 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP); triaged by the bob-cli-os land agent.

`spotify::resolve_short_link` already returns the downloaded final episode page (`ResolvedShortLink.body`), and `podcast::dossier::prepare` / `metadata::fetch_episode` already accept a `prefetched_page`. But both callers drop the body. `spotify::prepare_create_target` returns only the final URL, and its `ScratchDir` (holding the body) is dropped when it returns. `ingest.rs::spotify_ingest_url` does the same. Then `create/podcast_route.rs::prepare_dossier` and `ingest.rs::ingest_podcast_route` pass `None`. So every spotify.link / spoti.fi capture fetches the episode page twice.

Proposal: keep the short-link scratch alive and thread the body path through `CreateOptions` (create) and through the ingest route, so `prepare` reuses it. Reuse it only when the final status was 200 and the final URL parsed as the same episode. Add a fake-curl test that counts episode-page requests for a short link (one, not two) on both create and ingest.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The epic plan noted that episode_route could reuse the body, but the delivered behavior is correct either way: it costs one extra HTTP request per short link, with no wrong output. It is a small efficiency follow-up outside the landed epic's acceptance criteria.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-os.5 noticed that spotify.link captures fetch the episode page twice, although the resolver already downloaded it. The plumbing to reuse it exists on both ends but is not connected.
